chapters.title: Your whole workflow. All yours.
chapters.text: Capture Studio. Your free, private workspace for the pages worth saving.

chapters.title: 01 / Install the unpacked extension
chapters.text: First, unzip the download. Open Chrome’s extensions page and turn on Developer mode. Click Load unpacked, choose the extracted folder, and pin Capture Studio.

chapters.title: 02 / Choose how much to capture
chapters.text: Open a page and choose how much to capture: the full page, the visible area, or a selected region. Keep the page active while capture runs.

chapters.title: 03 / Capture the complete email
chapters.text: Capturing a long email? Auto can find the reading pane. To pick a different area, choose scrolling area, click Full page, then select the message. Capture Studio stitches that pane from start to finish.

chapters.title: 04 / Annotate, redact, refine
chapters.text: Make your point with arrows, highlights, text, or numbered steps. For sensitive details, use solid Redact. You can undo and redo as you go.

chapters.title: 05 / Put your PDF on the right page
chapters.text: For a PDF, Auto suggests a paper size and orientation. Choose a standard size, or use Image-sized for one continuous page per capture part. Then export.

chapters.title: 06 / Lighter images, measured results
chapters.text: Need a smaller image? Choose JPEG or WebP, then adjust the size or quality. Check export size shows the actual file size before you save.

chapters.title: 07 / Compress an existing PDF
chapters.text: For an existing PDF, try Optimize to keep text and vectors. Rasterize makes image-based copies and removes searchable text and interactive features. Savings depend on the file.

chapters.title: 08 / Keep your collection local
chapters.text: Your captures stay in this browser. Search, reopen, and keep creating. Export important files as a backup.
